title: Minor Relief Features
definition: Minor relief features are the secondary, highly localized topographies located within the major ocean basin divisions (continental shelf, slope, deep sea plain, and deep ocean trenches), sculpted by tectonic, volcanic, and depositional processes.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC CSE Prelims through direct matching questions regarding specific oceanic landforms (e.g., guyots, seamounts, submarine canyons) and their morphology, while holding utility in Mains GS-1 (Geomorphology and Oceanography).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Minor Relief Features.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
